src/agent_runtime/profiling.py

Python · Tier A

Request-scoped runtime profiling helpers.

Details

The profiler is intentionally small and passive: it records timing and LLM usage from existing stage boundaries instead of becoming another pipeline.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
stable_json 18 Serialize a value stably for prompt-size accounting.
estimate_tokens 27 Return a cheap operational token estimate.
prompt_section_breakdown 69 Return safe prompt-section size accounting without storing section text.
latency_distribution 114 Return compact latency distribution stats for a list of millisecond values.
RuntimeProfiler 144 Collect request-local stage timings and LLM-call measurements.
RuntimeProfiler.stage_started 162 Mark a stage start if it is not already active.
RuntimeProfiler.stage_completed 168 Mark a stage completion and return its elapsed milliseconds.
RuntimeProfiler.detail_started 188 Mark a fine-grained detail span and return its span id.
RuntimeProfiler.detail_completed 211 Mark a detail span complete and return elapsed milliseconds.
RuntimeProfiler.detail 245 Context manager for fine-grained runtime spans.

RuntimeProfiler.close_open_stages 303 Close any stages left open by an exception or early return.
RuntimeProfiler.record_llm_call 311 Record one structured LLM request.
RuntimeProfiler.summary 407 Return a JSON-safe profile report for the request.
